list.footer: Give the address of your instrument network's gateway. Most WiFi gateways serve NMEA 0183 on port 10110. Everything switched on here feeds the same chart.

item_fields.label: Name
item_fields.desc: What you call this source. Leave it empty to show the address.

item_fields.label: Address
item_fields.desc: The name or IP address of the instrument network's gateway.

item_fields.label: Port
item_fields.desc: Most WiFi gateways serve NMEA 0183 on port 10110.

item_fields.label: On
item_fields.desc: Off closes the connection and stops reconnecting.
